lines.japanese:
―――夢を見た。
　いや、夢という自分のモノではないゆめを、見た。
　あの日。
　泣きながらこのカラダにすがりついて、自分のココロをわけてくれた、少女のゆめを見た。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish:
—I dreamed.
No—not a dream that belonged to me. I dreamed someone else’s dream. The dream of the girl who, that day, clung weeping to this body and shared her heart with me.

lines.maoEnglish: We live alone, and we die alone, Akiha.

lines.japanese:
それが、わたしが父に教えられた最初の言葉だった。
　意味なんて解るはずがない。
　ただそう語る父の瞳が硝子細工のように無機質で、ひどく不安になったコトだけを覚えている。
　この人はとても淋しい人で。
　自分もいつか、そうなってしまうと解ってしまったからだろう―――――
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish: Those were the first words my father ever taught me. Of course I couldn’t understand them. I remember only his eyes as he spoke: lifeless as things made of glass, and so terribly unsettling. Perhaps I already knew that he was a very lonely man—and that one day I would become the same.
lines.mao_english: Those were the first words my father ever taught me. Of course I couldn’t understand them. I remember only his eyes as he spoke: lifeless as things made of glass, and so terribly unsettling. Perhaps I already knew that he was a very lonely man—and that one day I would become the same.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Those were the first words father taught me.
I did not know what the words meant.
But I remember feeling uneasy, looking at father's inorganic eyes as he said those words.
He was a very lonely person.
And I knew that I would be like him someday----

lines.japanese:
―――遠野家の娘として生まれたわたしには、年上の兄がいた。
　わたしは、その兄とはどうしても仲良くなれなかった。
　両親はその少年を兄というけれど、わたしには何か別のモノに見えて仕方がなかったから。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish: —I was born a daughter of the Tohno family, and I had an older brother. No matter how I tried, I could never grow close to him. My parents called the boy my brother, but to me he could only ever seem like something else.
lines.mao_english: —I was born a daughter of the Tohno family, and I had an older brother. No matter how I tried, I could never grow close to him. My parents called the boy my brother, but to me he could only ever seem like something else.
lines.mirrorMoon:
---Born into the Tohno family, I had an older brother.
But I could not get along with him.
My parents told me he was my brother, but he seemed to me like something else.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
遠野の血筋のものは、すべからく異なる血を混ざらせる。
　だから兄は人間でないモノに見えるのだろうけど、わたしから見た兄は、『それ』でさえない気がした。
　わたしは、どうしても兄を心から受け入れる事ができなかった。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish:
Every Tohno carries a mingling of alien blood. Perhaps that was why my brother looked inhuman, but to my eyes he did not seem to be even that.
I could never accept my brother with all my heart.
lines.mao_english:

That might be why he looked different to me, but for me, he did not appear like "that" either.
I could not truly accept my brother.

lines.japanese:
そうしてわたしが六歳になったころ。
　もう一人の兄として、見知らぬ少年がわたしたちの生活に加わった。
　少年の、兄と同じ響きをした名前が、はじめはとても苦手だった。
　兄よりいくぶん年下の少年は、けれど大人びていて、誰にでも優しかった。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish: Then, around the time I turned six, an unfamiliar boy joined our lives as another brother. At first I hated how his name sounded the same as my brother’s. He was somewhat younger than my brother, but remarkably mature, and kind to everyone.
lines.mao_english: Then, around the time I turned six, an unfamiliar boy joined our lives as another brother. At first I hated how his name sounded the same as my brother’s. He was somewhat younger than my brother, but remarkably mature, and kind to everyone.

lines.japanese:
厳格な家訓に縛られていたわたしを、少年は当然のように色々な遊びに連れまわす。
　無言でその後をついていくうちに、わたしは言葉にはしないものの、この新しい兄に興味を持ちはじめた。
　うるさくて、おちつかなくて、らんぼうだけど。
　どうしてか、このひとは何があってもわたしを大事にしてくれているってわかったから。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish: I lived under a severe code of family rules, but the boy took me along on all sorts of adventures as though it were the most natural thing in the world. I followed him without a word and slowly, though I never said so, began to take an interest in my new brother. He was loud and restless and rough. Yet somehow I knew that, whatever happened, he would always treasure me.
lines.mao_english: I lived under a severe code of family rules, but the boy took me along on all sorts of adventures as though it were the most natural thing in the world. I followed him without a word and slowly, though I never said so, began to take an interest in my new brother. He was loud and restless and rough. Yet somehow I knew that, whatever happened, he would always treasure me.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Even though I was restricted by my family's creed, the boy took me around to play like it was completely normal.
As I followed him silently, I started to take interest in my new brother.
He was loud, unsettling, and a bit rough, but…
Somehow, I knew this person would protect me no matter what.

lines.japanese:
遠野の嫡子であるわたしは、兄や少年とは離れた部屋で生活していた。
　遠野という特別な血のために、わたしにはまっとうな生活は許されないと父は言う。
　体や心を削るだけの学習としつけの時間を、わたしは受け入れる事でやりすごした。
　……父は憎くてこんな事をしているんじゃない。
　わたしを、秋葉をアイシテイルから、とてもとても厳しくわたしを叱るんだ、と自分に言い聞かせて。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish:
As the Tohno heir, I lived in rooms apart from my brother and the boy. Father said the special blood of the Tohnos meant that an ordinary life could never be permitted to me.
I survived the hours of lessons and discipline that did nothing but wear away my body and mind by accepting them without protest. Father wasn’t doing this because he hated me. He scolded me so very, very harshly because he LOVED me—because he loved his Akiha. That was what I told myself.
lines.mao_english:

I survived the hours of lessons and discipline that did nothing but wear away my body and mind by accepting them without protest. Father wasn’t doing this because he hated me. He scolded me so very, very harshly because he LOVED me—because he loved his Akiha. That was what I told myself.
lines.mirrorMoon:

I managed to endure strict studies by accepting my fate.
…… Father is not doing this because he does not like me.
I tell myself that he scolds me really, really harshly only because he loves me.

　もとからあったココロというものがすり減って、削られて、どんどんどんどん小さくなっていく。
　けれど、耐えていける気がしてた。
　たとえほんのわずかな時間だけでも。
勉強が終われば、外に出てみんなと遊べる自由があるんだからと。

lines.maoEnglish:
My heart wore away. Whatever it was that people called a heart was rubbed thin, pared down, growing smaller and smaller and smaller.
But I thought I could endure it. Even if my freedom lasted only a little while, once the lessons ended I could go outside and play with everyone.

兄も、少年と自分たちが違うモノである事は解っているみたいだった。
　普通のひととこうして、子犬みたいにはしゃぎまわれる時間がすぐに過ぎてしまうことも解っている。
　解っているからこそ、この時間を大事にしたかった。
　いつか成人して、この檻みたいな屋敷の中で独りきりになったとき。
　この思い出さえあれば、泣かないで、寂しいときも穏やかでいられますようにと。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish: My brother, too, seemed to understand that the boy was different from us. He knew that this time, when we could romp with an ordinary person like puppies, would soon be over. Because we both knew it, we wanted to treasure it. Someday, when I was grown and all alone inside this cage of a mansion, perhaps these memories would let me bear the lonely hours calmly, without tears.

lines.japanese:
夏の、暑い日。
　中庭で兄の姿を見かけて、わたしは歩みよった。
　兄は苦しそうにはあはあと息をはいて、地面にうずくまっている。
　なにか、厭な風がしていた。
　蝉の声が耳について、ぐらりと地面が傾いていく。
　平衡感覚がゆらゆらになっていく気分に酔いながら、わたしは兄に声をかけた。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish:
One hot summer day, I saw my brother in the courtyard and went to him. He was crouched on the ground, panting as though in terrible pain.
Something in the wind felt wrong.
The shrilling cicadas caught inside my ears, and the earth pitched beneath me. Drunk on the slow collapse of my balance, I called out to my brother.

I could hear the cicadas and the ground seemed to tilt.
Feeling myself starting to get dizzy, I called out to my brother.

　いつか。
いつか自分もああなってしまうだろうかという嫌悪に、体が凍りついてしまって。
　血に飢えたケモノはわたしに襲いかかってくる。
　わたしは逃げることができない。
　その時、手がひかれた。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish:
The brother who turned to face me was not my brother.
He had become some hideous beast, and at the sight I lost all power to move. My body froze with the revulsion of wondering whether someday—someday—I would become the same.
The blood-starved beast sprang at me. I could not run. And then someone caught my hand.

All I could do was watch my brother turn into an ugly beast.

The blood-thirsty beast attacked me.
I could not run away.
At that moment, someone pulled on my hand.

　けれど、ケモノはわたししか見ていなかった。
　逃げるわたしに襲いかかってくるケモノと、その間に割ってはいる少年。

It may have been wicked, but I hugged the body of the brother who had died for me and cried from happiness. Whatever the future brought, knowing there could never be anyone else for me seemed the greatest happiness in the world.

lines.japanese:
口にして、どうしようもなくこみ上げた。
　……もう、何年も前の出来事。
　俺自身も忘れていた遠い誓い。
　いつも、いつも他人だった家族たち。
　それでも―――本当の家族になろうって努力していた自分と、ただひとり、本当の家族以上に俺を思っていてくれた少女。
　そんなもの、初めから嘘だってわかっていた。
　けど、その作り事を守ろうとしていた自分たち。
　……本当に、知らなければよかった。
　それはなんて脆くて、ガラスのように、とおといゆめだったんだろう。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish:
The moment I said it aloud, the feeling became impossible to contain. A promise from so many years ago, forgotten even by me. The family who had always, always remained strangers. The boy who had nevertheless tried to make them into a true family—and the one girl who had cared for him more deeply than any real family ever could.
We had known from the beginning that it was a lie. Still, we had tried to protect that beautiful fiction. I truly wished I had never learned the truth. How fragile it had been, how precious—a dream made of glass.

We had known from the beginning that it was a lie. Still, we had tried to protect that beautiful fiction. I truly wished I had never learned the truth. How fragile it had been, how precious—a dream made of glass.

I knew it was a lie from the beginning.

…… Really, I wish I never knew.
What a fragile and far away dream it was.

If she has changed, then Akiha is no longer there. Only through death can she finally become Akiha Tohno again.”

「――――はい。
さよなら、遠野くん」
　去り際。
　先輩の声が、遠く聞こえた。

屋敷についた。
　頭痛がする。
　視界は靄がかかったように空ろ。

「は………あ」
　視界が歪む。
　呼吸がうまくできなくて、空気を吸いこむなんていうコトだけで眩暈がした。
　ずっ、と踏み出す一歩が、何百メートルにも感じられる。
　体は。
　疲れきり磨耗し尽くし、とっくに感覚を無くしていた。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish:
“Then I’m going. Thank you for everything. And goodbye.” I began to walk, holding the agony of the wound at bay.
“—Yes. Goodbye, Tohno.” As I left, her voice seemed to come from very far away.
I reached the mansion.
My head ached. My vision was hollow, filmed with mist.
“Hah… ah.” The world warped. I couldn’t breathe properly; merely drawing air into my lungs made me reel. Every dragging step felt hundreds of meters long. My body was exhausted, scoured empty, and had long since lost all sensation.

lines.japanese:
―――ただ、自然にここに来た。
　間違いはない。
　どくん、と膨張する心臓。
　喉が熱い。
　肉体は疲れきって、ただ生きているというコトを維持するだけに全ての機能を費やしている。
　こんな体で戦う、なんて行為は自殺と同意か。
　だが怖れは感じない。
　手に持ったナイフの重みに指が痺れる。
　神経が剥き出しになったような、この感覚。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish:
—I had simply come here, as though it were the most natural thing in the world.
There was no mistaking it. My heart swelled with one heavy thud. My throat burned. Every function of my exhausted body was devoted merely to keeping me alive. To fight in this condition—was that any different from suicide? Yet I felt no fear. The weight of the knife numbed my fingers. My nerves felt stripped bare.

It's suicidal to fight like this.

My fingers are paralyzed by the weight of my knife.
My nerves feel frayed.

lines.maoEnglish:
“Who knows? I don’t understand it myself. The part of me called SHIKI wants only Akiha. Drinking the blood of filthy mongrels was never to my taste.” “…That didn’t stop you from attacking anyone you pleased.” “No, it certainly didn’t. But what choice did I have? That wasn’t my will.”
“It echoes inside me, Shiki. A thought that says kill without end, take without end, destroy everything. I merely obey it. I don’t know why.” “…That’s terrible. I can hardly remember anymore, but you weren’t like this in the old days, SHIKI.”

But what are you, when you don’t possess even that—when your blood simply gives you orders? I’m asking what you are when you kill without a will of your own, Shiki Nanaya!” “……” I walked. To kill him—
lines.mao_english: “Listen. Even I still have standards by which I judge myself. I know that what I do is evil in your eyes. We exist with full knowledge of that choice! But what are you, when you don’t possess even that—when your blood simply gives you orders? I’m asking what you are when you kill without a will of your own, Shiki Nanaya!” “……” I walked. lines.mirrorMoon:
"Alright?
I still have a mind that lets me choose.
I know what I'm doing is considered evil for you guys, but we do it knowing that……!
But what are you, being controlled by your blood?
I'm asking what are you trying to kill without any will of your own, Nanaya Shiki……!!!"
"---------"
I walk.
To, kill, him----

lines.japanese:
「ふざけやがって……！
　今のおまえがどんな目をしているのか解っているのか？
　おまえは生き物なんかじゃない。
意思のない機械と同じで、人間外のものなら無条件で殺そうとする人形じゃねえか！
　ああ、親父が七夜の人間を皆殺しにしたのは当然だぜ。
だっておまえのほうこそさあ、感情がない殺人鬼そのものなんだからな……！」
「――――――――」
　最後の一歩。
　これで、確実に。
　この化け物を、殺すコトができる――――
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish: “Don’t mock me! Do you know what your eyes look like now? You aren’t even alive. You’re a mindless machine, a doll that kills anything inhuman without question! No wonder Father exterminated the Nanayas. You’re the true murderer here—a killer without a shred of feeling!” “……” One final step. Now I could kill this monster. Certainly. Absolutely—
lines.mao_english: “Don’t mock me! Do you know what your eyes look like now? You aren’t even alive. You’re a mindless machine, a doll that kills anything inhuman without question! No wonder Father exterminated the Nanayas. You’re the true murderer here—a killer without a shred of feeling!” “……” One final step. Now I could kill this monster. Certainly. Absolutely—
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Shit……!
Do you know how you look right now?
You're not a living thing.
You're like a machine, a doll that kills anything not human!
I see, it was only right that the old man exterminated the Nanaya.
Because you're all emotionless killers……!"
"---------"
The last step.
With this,
I will be able to kill this monster----

lines.japanese:
「―――ほら、おまえはそういうヤツなんだよ志貴！
　人間じゃないヤツが相手なら、相手がどれだけ人間と酷似していても殺すだけなんだろう？
　なら。
おまえはオレを仕留めた後、秋葉も同じように殺すっていうんだな？」
「――――――、」
　なに、を。
　そんな、こと、は―――――――
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish:
“There! That’s what you are, Shiki! If something isn’t human, you kill it, no matter how perfectly it resembles one. So after you finish me, you mean to kill Akiha the same way?”
“……” What was he—? That couldn’t—
lines.mao_english:
“There! That’s what you are, Shiki! If something isn’t human, you kill it, no matter how perfectly it resembles one. So after you finish me, you mean to kill Akiha the same way?”
“……” What was he—? That couldn’t—
lines.mirrorMoon:
"---See, that's the kind of creature you are, Shiki.
If you're fighting anyone not human, all you do is kill them no matter how much they look human.
Then, are you going to kill Akiha too after you kill me?"
"------"
What in the world?
I would never-------

lines.japanese:
「ない、と言いきれるのか？
　言っておくけどな、秋葉はオレなんかより数段化け物じみているんだぜ？
　そんなモノを前にして、おまえの理性が衝動を抑えきれる筈がないんだ。
　……ほら、まだおまえに七夜志貴としてではなく、遠野志貴としての理性が残っているんなら解るだろう。
　おまえはここでオレに殺されるか、それとも――――自分で自分を始末したほうが救われるんだっていうコトがな――――！！」
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish: “Can you swear you won’t? Akiha is several times more monstrous than I am. Faced with such a creature, your reason could never restrain that impulse. Come now—if there’s any reason left in you as Shiki Tohno rather than Shiki Nanaya, you understand. Your only salvation is to let me kill you here, or else—to finish yourself with your own hands!”
lines.mao_english: “Can you swear you won’t? Akiha is several times more monstrous than I am. Faced with such a creature, your reason could never restrain that impulse. Come now—if there’s any reason left in you as Shiki Tohno rather than Shiki Nanaya, you understand. Your only salvation is to let me kill you here, or else—to finish yourself with your own hands!”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Can you say that you won't?
I'll tell you, but Akiha is more like a monster than I am.
With her in front of you, there's no way you'll be able to hold down your impulse.
…… See, if you have any reasoning left in you as Tohno Shiki and not Nanaya Shiki, you should understand.
You are going to be killed by me, or----that it's best if you kill yourself----!!"

lines.japanese:
「――――――――――！」
　消えた。
　いや、逃げたのか。
　ガサガサと草を掻き分ける音がする。
　ヤツは森の奥に逃げていく。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish: “—!” He vanished. No—he fled. Grass thrashed in the distance as he escaped deeper into the forest.
lines.mao_english: “—!” He vanished. No—he fled. Grass thrashed in the distance as he escaped deeper into the forest.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"------------!"
He disappears.
No, he ran away.
I can hear the sound of the grass as he runs.
He is running into the forest.
lines.mirror_moon:
"------------!"

lines.japanese:
「――――――――――あ」
　……逃がしてしまった。
　今なら確実に仕留められたのに、逃がしてしまった。
　どうしてだろう。
　それに怒りを覚えている自分と、どこか―――良かった、と思う自分が、いるなんて。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish: “—Ah.” I had let him escape. I could have killed him with certainty, and I had let him go. Why did part of me rage at that while another, somewhere deep inside, whispered that it was glad?
lines.mao_english: “—Ah.” I had let him escape. I could have killed him with certainty, and I had let him go. Why did part of me rage at that while another, somewhere deep inside, whispered that it was glad?
lines.mirrorMoon:
"------------Oh."
…… I let him get away.
I could have definitely killed him, but I let him get away.
Why?
Part of me is angry----part of me thinks it was a good thing.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「……逃がすわけには、いかない」
　……草むらに血の跡が続いている。
　片腕を切断したのだ。
　血の跡は明確に、ヤツの居場所を教えてくれる。
　だが、急がなければ見失ってしまうかもしれない。
lines.label: s375
lines.maoEnglish: “…I can’t let him get away.” A trail of blood continued through the grass. I had severed his arm, and the blood pointed plainly toward him. But unless I hurried, I might still lose the trail.
lines.mao_english: “…I can’t let him get away.” A trail of blood continued through the grass. I had severed his arm, and the blood pointed plainly toward him. But unless I hurried, I might still lose the trail.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… I can't let him get away."
…… There is a trail of blood on the grass.
I cut off one of his arms.
His trail of blood will tell me exactly where he went.
But if I don't hurry up, I might lose him.

――――ここで躊躇っている余裕はない。
　ヤツの傷が癒える前に仕留めなければ、逆にこちらが殺されてしまうだろう。
「は――――――あ」
　疲れきった体を抱えて、シキの後を追いかけた。
lines.label: s376
lines.maoEnglish:
There was no time to hesitate. If I didn’t finish him before his wounds closed, I would be the one who died.
“Haaah…” Dragging my exhausted body along, I ran after SHIKI.

はぁ、はぁ、はぁ、はぁ―――――
　暗い森に、自分の呼吸音が反響していく。
　この闇の中、赤い血の跡は蛍光灯のように光って見えた。
　これなら何があってもシキを逃がす事はない。
　問題は、俺の体がそれまで保ってくれるかどうかだ。
lines.label: s376
lines.maoEnglish:
Hah, hah, hah, hah—
My breath echoed through the dark woods. In that blackness, the trail of red blood shone as brightly as a fluorescent lamp. I couldn’t possibly lose SHIKI now. The only question was whether my body would last long enough to catch him.

lines.mirrorMoon:

My breath echoes through the dark forest.
In this darkness, the trail of blood seems to light the way.
There's no way I'll let SHIKI go now.
The question is, can my body survive long enough?

lines.japanese:
「はぁ――――はっ、はっ、はっ―――――」
　よろけながら、眩暈を誤魔化しながら走る。
　左手にはナイフの感触。
　強く握った掌から伝わる、その感触だけが、かろうじて意識を繋ぎとめていてくれる。
「あいつ……中庭に、向かっている、のか」
　血の跡は中庭に続いているようだった。
　八年前。
　七夜志貴が遠野シキに殺された場所。
　……言われてみれば、あそこほど俺たちの決着に相応しい場所はないかもしれない。
lines.label: s376
lines.maoEnglish:
“Haaah—hah, hah, hah—” I ran on, reeling, fighting down the vertigo. The knife was solid in my left hand. Only that hard shape biting into my clenched palm kept the fraying thread of my consciousness intact.
“Is he… heading for the courtyard?”
The blood trail seemed to lead into the courtyard. Eight years ago, that was where Shiki Nanaya had been killed by SHIKI Tohno. Come to think of it… perhaps nowhere else could have been more fitting for our final reckoning.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
Breathing heavily,
I run while wobbling side to side.
I feel my knife in my left hand.
The sensation of the knife firmly gripped by my hand is the only thing keeping me from passing out.
"Is he…… going to the courtyard?"
It looks like the trail of blood leads to the courtyard.
Eight years ago.
The place where Nanaya Shiki was killed by Tohno SHIKI.
…… Come to think of it, there's no better place to finish our match.

　目の前が、血に染まった。
lines.label: s376
lines.maoEnglish:
“Fine, SHIKI. Right there, I’ll kill you,” I whispered.
The world before me flooded red.

Kill you.

「ご――――――ふ」
　吐いた息から血があふれてくる。
　心臓から血が逆流してくる。
　意識が遠くなって、そのまま――――地面に倒れこんだ。
「え――――――？」
　ワケが解らない。
　ただ痛みと、熱い、感覚だけが、全身に、染み込んでいく。
lines.label: s376
lines.maoEnglish: “Guh—” Blood spilled out with my breath. It surged backward from my heart. My awareness receded, and I collapsed face-first onto the ground. “What…?” I couldn’t understand. There was only pain, and heat, soaking slowly into every part of me.
lines.mao_english: “Guh—” Blood spilled out with my breath. It surged backward from my heart. My awareness receded, and I collapsed face-first onto the ground. “What…?” I couldn’t understand. There was only pain, and heat, soaking slowly into every part of me.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Gu-------ugh."
Blood accompanies my breath out of my body.
Blood spews out of my heart.
I start to pass out and----fall to the ground.
"What----?"
I don't understand.
I just feel pain and burning everywhere.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Gu-------ugh."

"What----?"

lines.japanese:
「―――――そん、な」
　ふと、自分の背中を見た。
　そこには翼のように無数の剣が生えていた。
　無数の剣は俺の体の内部から、外に向けて屹立している。
　つまり、それが。
　俺の致命傷、という事らしい。
「なん、で―――――？」
　わからない。
　剣が飛んできたワケでもない。
　ただいきなり、俺の内部から外に向けて生えるように、剣が突き出してきただけだ。
lines.label: s376
lines.maoEnglish: “No… way…” I twisted around to look at my own back. Countless blades had sprouted there like wings. They stood rigid, thrusting outward from inside my body. So those, apparently, were my mortal wounds. “Why…?” I didn’t understand. No swords had come flying at me. They had simply appeared without warning, bursting out of my body as though they had grown there.
lines.mao_english: “No… way…” I twisted around to look at my own back. Countless blades had sprouted there like wings. They stood rigid, thrusting outward from inside my body. lines.mirrorMoon:
"-----What the…"
I look at my back.
There I see numerous swords stuck like wings.
They stick through me and up towards the sky.
That means…
This wound is fatal.
"Why-----?"
I don't understand.
It's not that these swords came flying at me.
They just suddenly seemed to sprout from inside me.

ぴちゃり、ぴちゃり、という音。
　赤い剣は血液をこぼしている。
　それは俺の血というワケではなく――――
「―――――そう、か。
あの時の、血か」
　……さっきシキを切りつけた時の返り血。
　それが胸に残ったままだった。
　……なんていう未熟さだろう。
　あの赤い剣がヤツの血液で出来ているって解っていたんだから―――あいつの返り血を浴びるなんていう事は、いつでも串刺しにしてくださいって言っているようなものだったんだ。
lines.label: s376
lines.maoEnglish:
Drip. Drip. The red blades were shedding blood. But it wasn’t my blood—
“Oh… I see. The blood from before.”
The spray that had struck me when I cut SHIKI. Some of it had remained on my chest. What a miserable novice I was. I already knew his red blades were made from his blood—letting that blood spatter me was as good as begging him to skewer me whenever he pleased.
lines.mao_english:
Drip. Drip. The red blades were shedding blood. But it wasn’t my blood—
“Oh… I see. The blood from before.”
The spray that had struck me when I cut SHIKI. Some of it had remained on my chest. What a miserable novice I was. I already knew his red blades were made from his blood—letting that blood spatter me was as good as begging him to skewer me whenever he pleased.
lines.mirrorMoon:
The sound of dripping blood.
It drips down the swords on my body.
The blood is not mine---
"----Oh, that blood back then."
…… The blood that spilled on me when I cut SHIKI.
That was still on my chest.
…… What a stupid mistake.
I knew that red swords were made from his blood---so having his blood on me is like asking him to stab me to death any time he pleases.

lines.japanese:
「――――――ぁ」
　意識が遠ざかる。
　自らの血の海に沈んで、ぼんやりと空を見上げた。
　遠い月。
　暗い夜、高い木々。
　いつかと同じ、無意味な死をここに迎えていた。
lines.label: s376
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah…” My consciousness drifted away. Sinking into a sea of my own blood, I stared vaguely up at the sky.
The distant moon. The dark night, the towering trees. Here I was, meeting the same meaningless death as before.
lines.mao_english:
“Ah…” My consciousness drifted away. Sinking into a sea of my own blood, I stared vaguely up at the sky.
The distant moon. The dark night, the towering trees. Here I was, meeting the same meaningless death as before.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"------Ah."
I start to fade.
I look up at the sky in my own sea of blood.
The far away moon.
Dark night, tall trees.
I am facing the same meaningless death as once before.
lines.mirror_moon:
"------Ah."
I start to fade.
I look up at the sky in my own sea of blood.
The far away moon.
Dark night, tall trees.
I am facing the same meaningless death as once before.

lines.japanese:
「――――――――」
　大きく、息をついた。
「はぁ……はぁ……、あ」
　呼吸が戻ってくる。
　さっきまで朱に染まっていた視界がマトモに戻っていく。
「は――――――あ」
　シキの言うコトを認めるつもりはない。
　俺は秋葉を殺すコトなんて絶対にしないし、相手が人間じゃないから、無条件で殺すなんていうコトは、ないんだ。
lines.label: s378
lines.maoEnglish:
“…” I let out one long breath.
“Hah… hah… ah.” My breathing steadied. The crimson haze over my sight began to clear. “Haaah…” I would never concede that SHIKI was right. I would never kill Akiha, and I would never kill someone without question merely because they weren’t human.
lines.mao_english:
“…” I let out one long breath.
“Hah… hah… ah.” My breathing steadied. The crimson haze over my sight began to clear. “Haaah…” I would never concede that SHIKI was right. I would never kill Akiha, and I would never kill someone without question merely because they weren’t human.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"---------"
I let out a deep breath.
Calming down,
I manage to restore control over my breathing.
My view painted in red now returns to normal.
One more calming breath.
I won't believe what SHIKI says.
I would never kill Akiha, and there's no way I would kill someone simply because they weren't human.

lines.mirror_moon:
Grunting with exertion, I jump from the puddle of blood and roll onto the ground.
…… But I couldn't get away unscathed.
My left arm is useless now.
My left arm wasn't stabbed, but cut from the inside out.
…… In other words…
The blood I wiped off with this arm cut through me like an exploding firework.

lines.japanese:
「あ――――ぐ…………！」
　地面に転がって、なんとか痛みを堪える。
　不幸中の幸いだ。
もしあの時胸の血をぬぐっていなかったら、俺は背中から剣を生やして即死していた。
lines.label: s380
lines.maoEnglish: “Agh…!” I writhed on the ground and somehow endured the pain. It was a blessing buried in disaster. If I hadn’t wiped the blood from my chest, swords would have burst from my back and killed me instantly.
lines.mao_english: “Agh…!” I writhed on the ground and somehow endured the pain. It was a blessing buried in disaster. If I hadn’t wiped the blood from my chest, swords would have burst from my back and killed me instantly.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Agh------gh………!!"
I roll on the ground and fight the pain.
I still got lucky.
If I hadn't of wiped that blood off my chest, I would have grown swords out of my back and died instantly.

「往生際が悪いぜ、頼むから今ので死にやがれってんだ―――――！！」

lines.maoEnglish: “Tch—!” I heard him. Grass tore beneath pounding feet. “Just die already! Why couldn’t that finish you?!” He was coming. Flat on the ground, I had no way to meet SHIKI’s attack.

「え―――――――――？」
　声をあげたのは、シキのほうだった。
　シキの腕は俺の胸ではなく、地面を抉っている。
　……別に、なんという事はない。
　何度も何度も同じ殺され方をしたものだから、たんに体のほうが慣れていただけ。
　遠野志貴は、自分の胸を貫こうとした敵の腕をかわして、そのまま敵の腹部に走っていた『線』を切断していた。

lines.maoEnglish:
“What—?!” The cry came from SHIKI. His arm had gouged the earth, not my chest. It was nothing miraculous. After being killed the same way so many times, my body had simply learned.
Shiki Tohno had slipped past the arm meant to pierce his chest and severed the ‘line’ running across his enemy’s abdomen.

Tohno Shiki simply avoided the enemy's arm and then cut across the line on the enemy's torso.

lines.mao_english: “You’re… kidding.” With a wet slide, SHIKI’s body shifted sideways. Bracing the halves together desperately with one arm, he staggered back.

SHIKI's body slides to one side.

「なんで――――なんで、なんで、なんで？
　なあ志貴、おかしいよ。
この傷、どうして――――簡単に、くっついて、くれないんだ？」
　ひきつった笑みをうかべて、シキはよろよろと後退していく。
　少しずつズレていく上半身と下半身。
　それを片腕で、必死に押さえつけているシキの姿は、サーカスの道化のようだった。

“Why—why, why, why? Shiki, this is wrong. Why won’t this wound… just close?” A rigid smile on his face, SHIKI stumbled backward.
His upper and lower body slid farther apart by degrees. The sight of SHIKI desperately holding himself together with one arm was like a clown at the circus.

lines.mao_english: “—” I gripped the knife. Strangely, I felt no sorrow. My heart seemed hollowed out. I wanted to feel nothing at all. “Akiha—” Leaves crunched underfoot as I walked toward her. She noticed me and welcomed me with a smile.
lines.mirrorMoon:

Surprisingly, I feel no sadness.

"Akiha---"
I step on the dead autumn leaves as I walk towards her.
Akiha notices me and greets me with a smile.

「―――――せめて」
　ナイフを強く握る。
　秋葉は、笑った。
　あはははは、と楽しそうに笑って、自らを殺そうとする俺を、迎えている。
「―――――っ」
　決心が鈍る。
　けど、もう歩き出してしまった。
lines.label: s381
lines.maoEnglish: “At least—” I tightened my grip on the knife. Akiha laughed. Ahahahahaha—she laughed merrily, greeting me as I came to kill her. “—!” My resolve faltered. But I had already begun to walk.
lines.mao_english: “At least—” I tightened my grip on the knife. Akiha laughed. Ahahahahaha—she laughed merrily, greeting me as I came to kill her. “—!” My resolve faltered. But I had already begun to walk.

Akiha laughs.

"-------!!"
My mind weakens.

―――殺して、ください
　散りゆく紅葉。
―――それが、おまえの最後の望みだったから。
lines.label: s381
lines.maoEnglish:
—Sometimes death could be salvation.
I kept walking. Akiha did not run. She waited for me, smiling with delight.
—Please kill me.
Maple leaves fell around us.
—Because that had been your final wish.

秋葉は笑っている。
　もう、これ以上近寄れる距離がない。
　あとはこの腕を突き出すだけで、よかった。
―――俺は、どんなに辛くても
「おまえを、殺さないといけない」
　告げて。
　不意に、涙があふれた。
lines.label: s381
lines.maoEnglish:
Akiha was smiling. There was no distance left to close. All I had to do was drive my arm forward.
—No matter how much it hurt, I—
“I have to kill you.”
The moment I said it, the tears came.

―――殺せるはずが、ない。
「……生きていてほしいんだ」
　不思議そうに首をかしげる秋葉。
「どんな姿になっても―――俺はおまえに生きていてほしいんだ、秋葉」
　涙は止まってくれない。
　秋葉は嬉しそうに抱き返して―――俺の首筋に、がちりと歯をつきつけた。
lines.label: s382
lines.maoEnglish:
There was no way I could kill her.
“…I want you to live.”
Akiha tilted her head, puzzled.
“No matter what you become, I want you to go on living, Akiha.”
The tears wouldn’t stop. Akiha happily returned my embrace—then set her teeth hard against my throat.

Pain. This wasn’t a bite meant to drink blood. It was the primitive act of biting straight through.

「あ―――あき、は」
　秋葉はただ、一心不乱に噛みついてくる。
　がり、と肉が裂かれて骨が削られる。
　秋葉に理性はない。
　抱きしめている相手が誰であるかも、抱きしめるという行為の意味さえもわからない。
　秋葉は、ヒトのカタチをしたケモノと変わらない。
　けど、それでも――――
lines.label: s382
lines.maoEnglish:
“A-Aki…ha.”
She bit down with mindless abandon. Flesh tore with a grating crunch; teeth scraped bone. There was no reason left in Akiha. She no longer knew whom she held, or even what it meant to hold someone.
Akiha was nothing but a beast in human shape. But even so—

「―――それでも……生きていて、ほしいんだ」
　……そう願うことはいけないのか。
　たとえ秋葉が人を殺してまわるようなモノになってしまっても、それでも生きていてほしいと思うのは罪なのか。
　秋葉が。
そんな自分には耐えられないといっても、俺は、それに耐えて欲しい。

lines.maoEnglish:
“Even so… I want you to live.”
…Was it wrong to wish for that? Even if Akiha became something that roamed the streets killing people, was it a sin to want her alive? Even if she said she could never endure becoming such a thing, I wanted her to endure it.

「俺が、おまえの唯一人の相手だから、さ」
―――優しく、秋葉の命を止めた。
lines.label: s382
lines.maoEnglish:
If someone is destined to kill you one day—
“I won’t let anyone hurt you.”
The knife moved without a sound—almost certainly without pain.
“Because I’m the one—and only one—for you.”
And gently, I brought Akiha’s life to a halt.

紅葉が散っていく。
　赤い地面。
そこに、秋葉は横になっている。
　地面に広がる髪は黒。
鮮やかに、赤い葉っぱの中でうねっている。
　死に顔は穏やかで、まるで幸せな夢を見ているように、思えた。
lines.label: s382
lines.maoEnglish: Crimson leaves drifted down. Akiha lay upon the red earth, her black hair fanned across it, curling vividly among the scarlet leaves. Her face was peaceful in death. She looked as though she were dreaming something happy.
lines.mao_english: Crimson leaves drifted down. Akiha lay upon the red earth, her black hair fanned across it, curling vividly among the scarlet leaves. Her face was peaceful in death. She looked as though she were dreaming something happy.

「―――――――――」
　或る、一つの出来事が、終わった。
　子供の頃。
　ここで待ち合わせて、中庭をかけまわった時の嬉しさも。
　二人きりで言葉もなく星の空を見上げ続けた時の眩しさも。
　つい、数日前。
　ここで、話した出来事も、全て。
lines.label: s382
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
Something had come to an end. The happiness of meeting here as children and racing through the courtyard. The radiance of sitting here alone together, gazing wordlessly at the stars.
Everything—even the conversation we’d shared here only a few days ago.

　意識が眠りに落ちる時のように、くらくらと揺らいでいく。
lines.label: s382
lines.maoEnglish: At some point, I found myself looking up at the moon. …My body was cold. My consciousness swayed and faltered as though sinking into sleep.
lines.mao_english: At some point, I found myself looking up at the moon. …My body was cold. My consciousness swayed and faltered as though sinking into sleep.

lines.japanese:
……眠い。
　もしこのまま眠りについてしまえば、全ては元通りになっているかもしれないなんていう、ゆめをみた。
　けどそれはゆめで、結局はいつか醒めてしまう。
　こうしてまどろんでいる自分さえ、一つのユメのように思える。
　それともすべては、はじめから邯鄲の夢だったのか。
　それなら、どうか。
　この夢のまま醒めることなく、眠り続けてくれれば良かったのに。
lines.label: s382
lines.maoEnglish:
…I was sleepy. I dreamed that if I fell asleep now, perhaps everything would be as it had been when I woke.
But a dream is still a dream, and in the end one always wakes. Even I, drowsing here like this, began to seem no more than a dream.
Or perhaps, from the very beginning, it had all been the Dream of Handan—a lifetime dreamed in a moment. If so—if only I could have gone on sleeping forever, never waking from this dream.

If so, please…
Let me sleep on and never wake me up.
